scope: Independent static read-only review of isolated practice brain, its 45-case suite, documentation and actual Rama kit tuning. No Godot, import, render or repository modifications performed.

findings.title: Volley candidate count overestimates first-hit coverage on a shared lane
findings.evidence: _volley_targets increments per visible candidate, rather than counting the nearest hittable target per distinct projectile lane. Actual Dawn Volley has max_hits=1 and lane offsets -0.105/0/+0.105.
findings.counterexample: After hard reaction, use ready cooldowns and visible enemies at (0,0,10) and (0,0,12). Both fit only the centre lane and produce count 2; the branch requests dawn_volley, although only its centre projectile can hit the first enemy and Piercing Dawn can reach both.
findings.suggestion: Use distinct first-hit lane coverage, or compare estimated unique first-hit receivers against Piercing Dawn; add the collinear-target negative case alongside the existing centre/right positive test.
findings.closure: Current lines 207-221 select the nearest candidate independently per projectile lane and deduplicate receiver IDs. The exact collinear two-target negative case at test lines 129-131 now expects Piercing Dawn, and the distinct centre/right positive case remains. Documentation line 63 describes this first-hit criterion.
